q: Aziz made a strong wall using a grey mixture of cement, sand, water, and small stones.
why: «grey mixture of cement, sand, water, and small stones» klivi qattiq devor qurish uchun ishlatiladigan betonni bildiradi.

wrong.cardboard: Qalin qog'oz turi, devor qurishga yaroqsiz.
wrong.ceramic: Pishirilgan loy buyum, devor uchun emas.

q: Malika wears a shiny yellow ring made from a very precious and expensive metal.
why: «shiny yellow ring» va qimmatbaho metall tilla (oltin) ekanini bildiradi.

wrong.iron: Temir qora metall, sariq va qimmatbaho uzuk emas.

q: Javohir bought a new small electronic device that makes his daily life much easier.
why: «small electronic device» iborasi gadjet so'ziga mos keladi.

q: The windows of our school are made of a clear, hard material that breaks easily.
why: «clear, hard material that breaks easily» shisha (deraza oynasi) ekanini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.stone: Tosh tiniq emas va oson sinmaydi.

q: My grandfather's old heavy gate is made of a strong dark metal that can rust in the rain.
why: «rust in the rain» va og'ir metall bu temir.

wrong.copper: Mis qizg'ish tusda va boshqacha zanglaydi.

q: Bekzod wears comfortable brown shoes made from the soft skin of an animal.
why: «soft skin of an animal» ishorasi teri (charm) materialini bildiradi.

wrong.nylon: Neylon sun'iy tola, hayvon terisi emas.

q: Dilshod writes his daily homework notes in a notebook using thin white sheets.
why: «thin white sheets» va notebook (daftar) so'zlari qog'ozni anglatadi.

wrong.stone: Toshga daftar varag'i sifatida yozib bo'lmaydi.

q: Ancient people built old fortress walls using heavy, hard pieces found in the mountains.
why: «heavy, hard pieces found in the mountains» tog' toshini bildiradi.

wrong.wood: Yog'och tog'dan topiladigan qattiq bo'lak emas.

q: The carpenter cut tall tree trunks to make a warm table and chairs for the room.
why: «tree trunks to make a table» bu yog'och (wood).

q: My soda can is made from a very light and soft silver metal that is easy to recycle.
why: «light and soft silver metal» va soda bankasi alyuminiy ekanini bildiradi.

q: We pack heavy books inside a strong brown ______ box before moving to a new house.
why: «strong brown box» buyumlarni ko'chirishda ishlatiladigan karton qutini anglatadi.

wrong.plastic: Plastmassa quti to'g'ri kelishi mumkin, lekin «brown box» kartonga xos.

q: Traditional tea cups and plates are often made of white ______ fired at a high temperature.
why: «tea cups and plates... fired at high temperature» keramika idishlarni bildiradi.

q: Electric cables use bright orange-red ______ inside because it carries electricity very well.
why: «carries electricity very well» va qizg'ish sim bu mis (copper).

q: My sister wears a strong synthetic ______ jacket that keeps her dry in the rain.
why: «strong synthetic» so'zi sun'iy tola bo'lgan neylonni ko'rsatadi.

q: Most kitchen water bottles and shopping bags are made of cheap colourful ______.
why: «shopping bags... cheap colourful» material bu plastmassa.

q: Skyscraper buildings in big cities are supported by a strong framework of heavy ______.
why: «strong framework» va «skyscraper buildings» iboralari «steel» (po'lat) ishlatilishini ko'rsatadi.

q: To protect his hands while fixing the car engine, Rustam wore heavy black gloves made of stretchy elastic material.
